messages.subject: unmarked version 0.12 released (now on CRAN)
parts:
Dear unmarked users
  Version 0.12 is now live on CRAN.  Big thanks to Mike Meredith for helping push this through over the last few days!  No big changes for this version but a few bug fixes and a few contributions from the community (Aurelie Fournier and Adam Smith -- thanks both), see below.  We added one function from the AHM book (pcount.spHDS for spatially explicit distance sampling) which is really just a minor hack of "pcount" (see AHM book ch. 9 for description and examples). Mainly this had to be in unmarked so that Mike could upload the AHM package to CRAN without duplicating a bunch of unmarked functionality.   We hope for some bigger additions to unmarked in future releases but right now we're a little distracted on other research and writing projects.
 regards,
andy


Version 0.12-0

  o Fixed mistake in turnover calculations in colext vignette (thanks
    to Giacomo Tavecchia)

  o added pcount.spHDS from AHM book.
 
  o updated predict method for pcount to include ZIP model
 
  o Adam Smith added some parallel capabilities to the parboot functionality
 
  o Adam Smith fixed formatMult conversion of julian date to factor
 
  o Aurelie Fournier fixed formatDistData
  
  o fixed error in obsToY for custom pi function
